title: Eleri Ward breaks free with soulful debut into the unfamiliar 'There You Go'
htmlContent:
Eleri Ward confidently embraces her own style with "There You Go," the first single from her eagerly awaited debut album featuring all original songs. Known for her beautiful acoustic renditions of Sondheim's work, Ward now takes a bold step forward, giving listeners a glimpse into her evolving musical journey.

"There You Go" combines sharp humor with deep personal insights, creating a powerful commentary on themes like entitlement, privilege, and insecurity. The song feels like a playful wink, wrapped in rich melodies, while its lyrics deliver a strong message. Her expressive voice effortlessly carries lines that explore important values: appreciating what you have instead of wanting more, the idea of karma, and the strength found in humility.

https://open.spotify.com/track/0VHiKO09MPoxJjR9Vfsy62

The track's overall sound is both personal and expansive, allowing Ward's storytelling to shine through while adding new layers to her music that show her growth as an artist.
